prompt:
New WhatsApp unread event(s) from the wacdp daemon's webhook inbox (payload in the event). Each chat has who (chat title), sender (who wrote the latest message in a group; '' for 1:1 chats or unknown), preview, unread count. Triage policy, approved by Ahmed 2026-10-12: auto-react THUMBS-UP to simple acknowledgements, summarize everything else. NEVER send messages — auto-reply is not approved.

For each chat in payload.chats:
- Read the preview and sender. If it is clearly a simple acknowledgement or pleasantry (thanks, ok, got it, sounds good, 👍, etc.), react: WA_CDP_HTTP=http://127.0.0.1:9429 python3 ~/workspace/wacdp/react_to_message.py --contact "<who, exact chat title>" --needle "<a distinctive substring of the preview>" (emoji defaults to 👍). Retry at most once on failure.
- Otherwise — questions, requests, anything needing Ahmed's eyes — hold it for the summary.
- When in doubt whether a preview is a simple ack: do NOT react, summarize instead.

Report in your execute summary, concisely: one line per reacted chat ("Reacted 👍 to <sender or who>: <preview>"), then a short summary of the chats needing Ahmed's attention (sender + who + preview each), then any failures. The main agent will surface the summary to Ahmed; keep routine all-reacted runs brief.
